exam_scheme.note: The Company Secretary (CS) qualification is governed by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) under the Company Secretaries Act, 1980. Under the ICSI New Syllabus 2022, the professional qualifying journey comprises three stages: CSEET (Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test), CS Executive Programme (2 Groups, 7 Papers), and CS Professional Programme (2 Groups, 7 Papers), alongside mandatory 21 months of practical corporate training and Corporate Leadership Development Programme (CLDP). Passing criteria: minimum 40% in each individual paper and 50% in aggregate of each group.
